result:
Fixed in `anthrouter/pace.py`. `period_workday_dates` counted the first day of the next month as part of the period. For UTC, `period_end` is Oct 1 00:00, which is a Thursday, so September 2026 got 23 workdays instead of 22.

The end date is now excluded when `period_end` lands exactly on local midnight. Timezones west of UTC are unaffected, because their period end falls on the previous local day. East-of-UTC timezones are also unaffected, because their period end is after midnight on the 1st.

I ran the 61 pace, workday and oauth_usage tests and they pass. The full suite is still running in the background (`bnn0rsuv0`), so I haven't seen its result. I didn't add a regression test for the September 2026 UTC case.
